name: M5.PolynomialExclusion.factor_dvd_quotient
statement: ∀ F P p : M5.BinaryPolynomial, F ≠ 0 → F ∣ P → (p ∣ P / F ↔ F * p ∣ P)
guidance: Forward multiply a witness of p|P/F by F and use EuclideanDomain.mul_div_cancel'. Reverse use EuclideanDomain.dvd_div_of_mul_dvd. Handles P=0 and arbitrary p; no primality is needed. Return only tactic lines without a leading by. Preserve exact statements.
